## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read and understand the complete change.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks and disclosed limitations.
- [ ] I added regression/failure-path tests where appropriate.
- [ ] I updated affected docs, compatibility and coverage.
- [ ] I verified dependency provenance, licences and attribution.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI assistance.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, local plans or reference clones are included.

A human must complete these checkboxes. AI self-review is not human approval.
